projects.title: RYNZA Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform
projects.problem: Delivers a complete online retail solution featuring a responsive customer storefront, a dedicated admin management panel, and secure payment processing.
projects.role: Full-Stack Developer - Engineered the application from scratch using the MERN stack, implementing JWT authentication, integrating the Stripe payment gateway, and styling with Tailwind CSS.

projects.title: AI-Powered Transaction Scrutinization Engine
projects.problem: Detects fraudulent financial transactions in real-time by processing credit card data through a machine learning model with a scoring latency of under 20ms.
projects.role: Backend & AI Engineer - Engineered the data features, trained the XGBoost fraud detection model, and built the highly secure FastAPI backend with JWT and Two-Factor Authentication.

projects.title: RYNZA Full-Stack E-Commerce & DevOps Pipeline
projects.problem: Automates the end-to-end deployment of a three-tier MERN application, replacing manual server configuration with a fully hands-off Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and CI/CD workflow.
projects.role: DevOps & Full-Stack Developer - Developed the React storefront and Node.js API, containerized the services with Docker, and engineered a complete CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins, Terraform, and Ansible on AWS.

projects.title: NexCart Multi-Tenant Mobile E-Commerce App
projects.problem: Enables multiple store administrators to manage their own separate retail storefronts, inventory, and customer bases within a single, unified mobile ecosystem.
projects.role: Mobile App Developer - Built the separate Flutter applications for customers and store admins, integrated Firebase for real-time NoSQL data storage, and configured the Stripe payment gateway.

projects.title: Automated Parking System
projects.problem: An automated parking system simulation bridging digital theory and hardware execution, featuring real-time occupancy tracking, edge detection for signal debouncing, and dynamic available slot visualization.
projects.role: Hardware Designer - Engineered the system logic using Verilog, implementing Finite State Machines (FSMs) and counters, and validated precise timing and synchronization using Icarus Verilog and GTKWave.
